notes.title: LUMbA: REDUX - The Sigma Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678785/3abc3ebd73a8533b8b2635b14d9f305b47b641ae.png[/img]
I'm getting ready to put LUMbA: REDUX on some more platforms, so I thought now would be a good time to add some extra stuff and fix some issues I still have with the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42678785/cc5e91fc6cf5ab599c5bb03cc3b3719fba837f1a.png[/img]

[h2]NEW MENU[/h2]

I completely redid the menu to make it more dynamic and stuff. The end result was pretty cool in my opinion, I hope you check it out :)

[h2]NEW CHAPTER(???)[/h2]

I felt chapter 7 was the weakest in the game. Outside of the Yellherr fight, you spend the entire thing walking forward like it's sonic.exe and that's BORRRIIINNNGGGG. I redid a lot of it. Since chapter 8 is just a boss, chapter 7 has always filled the role of the "final level." I tried to make something much more climatic this time around, I even made music for it myself (I have no experience with making music). I also removed that stupid jumpscare when Yellherr shows up. The original LUMbA was actually supposed to be a horror game and that part kinda got left over from it. It always felt out of place in this game so I replaced it with a short little cutscene.

[h2]OTHER SHIT[/h2]

I fixed and changed some other random stuff in this update as well:

[list]
[*] Fixed the Richard Rodent fight not working on the Steam Deck.
[*] Made The Machine fight work properly on gamepad.
[*] Slightly altered chapter 4's visuals.
[*] Zoomed in the camera of the Yellherr fight.
[*] Optimized the final boss.
[*] Some other thing I forgot
[/list]

This game was released almost 2 years ago and I still can't help but mess with it. I should really be working on LUMbA: HANGOVER's REMIX Mode but I just can't help myself with this game, lol.

[h1]THE ONE AND ONLY STEAMBOAT MOUSE GUY HAS JOINED LUMbA: REDUX![/h1]

notes.title: COMBAT OVERHAUL + Gamepad Support
notes.content:
We're really happy with the positive reception we've gotten after releasing LUMbA: REDUX. Some people had issues with the game though, many issues we felt like we couldn't ignore. So without further ado, [b]here are the new changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Lumba's movement speed was made more consistent between levels.
[*] Lumba's projectile speed has been increased.
[*] Added a new brick wall object, which has replaced large stacks of boxes in some levels.
[*] Modified enemy spawn positions in multiple levels.
[*] Lowered Flart bullet speed.
[*] Lowered Bonecrow firebone speed.
[*] Lowered G-Yip firerate.
[*] Added telegraphs showing the area covered by explosive bullets.
[/list]
[b]BOSS UPDATES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added boss health meters.
[*] Gave some bosses telegraphed animations to signal incoming attacks.
[*] Rebalanced boss health.
[*] Added new bullet sprites to differentiate the final boss's attacks.
[/list]
[b]GAMEPAD SUPPORT:[/b]
We added support for controllers, specifically Xbox controllers, but you can likely get any type of gamepad working with the right software.
ok I put out the super-update now I can sleep hahaha

notes.title: LUMbA: REDUX Update Recap
notes.content:
Team Lumba has been hard at work continuing to support LUMbA: REDUX. I recently got a Steamworks account, so now I can tell you guys about everything we've been doing.
[b]Boring Stuff:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted various enemies and bosses to suit a more natural difficulty curve
[*] Adjusted Lumba's speed in chapter 2
[*] Fixed Yellherr collision
[/list]
[b]LUMbA: WORLD TOUR is a free update that adds brand-new content, including:[/b]
[list]
[*] 3 New chapters
[*] 3 New monsters
[*] 1 New boss
[*] New story content
[/list]
